name: Soul Stasis
disable: DC 43 Arcana check or Religion (master) to reweave the magic within each pillar, DC 46 Thievery check (master) to disable each pillar, or dispel magic (8th level; counteract DC 43) to counteract each pillar
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any souls in the area.
routine: (4 actions) This trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled pillar. Each pillar uses 1 action to emit a 30-foot-radius burst of inhibiting energy that slows souls. Each non-psychopomp creature with a soul in the area is Slowed 1 unless they succeed at a DC 43 Fortitude save save.

items.name: Pulse
items.text:
Trigger A soul or creature with a soul enters the area

---

Effect The steel pillars activate with an audible hum that resonates with spirits. Each non-psychopomp creature with a soul is Stunned 3 unless they succeed at a DC 43 Will save save. The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Four steel pillars emit pulsing energy to slow souls' processes.
